register: Address the reader as คุณ (second person, often omitted). Use a friendly, modern, concise, polite-neutral tone with no ครับ/ค่ะ particles and no formal royal vocabulary. Keep common loanwords as openline.com does (eSIM, โรมมิ่ง, แคชแบ็ก, QR code, Tier-1) and keep sentences short and direct.
